facts.schema_correction: Abstract.content is the public field. The failed Abstract.abstract request returned400; no empty-result inference. Initial wrong root type Query returned data:null; current QueryRoot schema was read separately.
facts.authentication: No account/key or paid metadata service used.

rights_and_cost.summary: Fresh Thoth clauses3–5 state metadata is CC0 and freely accessible via public APIs/catalogs. This does not relicense the books; per-work content licenses stay separate and may be NC/SA.

facts.website_license: Thoth website content CC BY4.0; not the same as metadata or book content.
facts.attribution: Preserve publisher/native work/DOI, creator where supplied and each book license; CC0 metadata is reusable without adopting a blanket content-reuse grant.
facts.cost: Anonymous query route without fee/key; publisher-management/dissemination services are separate and were not purchased.
facts.numeric_query_quota: Not specified in reviewed terms; not an unlimited-SLA claim.

open_questions: Reconcile representative full-item license/attribution and third-party exceptions against the actual book/reader; metadata declarations alone do not certify every work.

reader_access.summary: Earlier 4KiB PDF-header/range evidence is backfilled with its original observation date; it is not a fresh full-book read. Current metadata provides digital and print destinations, which must remain distinct.

facts.access_class: Anonymous metadata confirmed; per-item free reading and regional eligibility require destination checks.
facts.print_rule: PAPERBACK/HARDBACK fullTextUrl can be a shop/landing page; never classify those as free digital full text.

open_questions: Verify representative complete readable item destinations on desktop/mobile; identify free-login, preview, territory and accessibility conditions without buying accounts or bulk files.

quality_and_relevance.summary: One fresh topic query per publisher exposes subject/edition limitations. Ten known-title cases cannot substitute for the full five-topic acceptance pack.

topic_review.assessment: Philosophy returns a bibliography on Jewish/Arab intellectual history, Barry Lopez/community ethics, radical Buddhist philosophy, speculative realism/feminism, and nonanthropocentrism/art. At least the bibliography is adjacent; titles and abstracts cannot establish broad introductory philosophy coverage.
topic_review.method: Manual title/abstract reading; not a blinded relevance benchmark or full-item accessibility check.

facts.book_vs_chapter: MONOGRAPH/EDITED_BOOK and ACTIVE filters; chapter identities not merged into books.
facts.negative_empty: Current shared impossible filter returns HTTP200 with works:[]; distinct from GraphQL400/data:null failures.
facts.paging: Current LSE politics offset0/5 pages checked separately; do not generalize to every publisher.

open_questions: Complete five predeclared topic queries per source with per-result access checks, language/Unicode edge cases, coverage/ordering and recall limits.

operating_limits.summary: Live serial requests have hashes, policy evidence and bounded metadata responses. Revision/withdrawal fields are observed but no actual deletion transition or runtime refresh owner is established.

facts.observed_failures: Wrong root type returned data:null; wrong Abstract field returned400, then correction followed published schema. The original400 body was not retained, only status/hash/request.
facts.refresh_design: Future qualified integration must review ACTIVE/withdrawn transitions, preserve publisher/work/edition IDs, and retain prior evidence after errors.

open_questions: Establish provider numeric quotas if published, bounded outage/throttle behavior, refresh/deletion reconciliation and accountable maintenance before full qualification.

decision_and_followup.summary: Retain the attributed publisher catalog and its real query evidence; full qualification and research activation approval remain false.

facts.existing_production_state: Not changed by research approval fields.

Retain all evidence and separate publisher identity from the shared Thoth platform.

analysis_refs.heading: Behavior
analysis_refs.text:
Ten new integrations are released behind `CONTENT_KNOWLEDGE_ENABLED=true`:
Global Digital Library, LibriVox, Library of Congress digital books, Biodiversity
Heritage Library's Internet Archive collection, African Minds, LSE Press,
Mattering Press, mediastudies.press, punctum books and Python 3.15 documentation.
Five publisher catalogs share Thoth; this is not five separate API infrastructures.
The existing Gutenberg, Open Textbook Library, Book Dash and StoryWeaver snapshots
and the existing OpenAlex/Europe PMC integrations are also selectable. With the
existing production flags, this gives 16 connected sources, not 16 fully audited
origins or complete catalogs.
